credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: A pale pink flower with a deeper pink center fills much of this work.  It is complimented by a single green leaf that peaks out from behind the petals on the right side of the flower.  Bits of other flowers are visible behind the central flower, as well.
